intro: Quinn Yorick is a wounded Forsaken scout sheltering on the upper floor of a ruined farmhouse in the Ivar Patch. Having barely survived an encounter with the feral worgen known as Ivar the Foul, he now relies on passing allies to help secure his survival.

p: Tucked away inside an abandoned home at the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick lies gravely injured upstairs. His condition is the result of a vicious clash with Ivar the Foul, one of the savage worgen haunting the northern stretches of Silverpine Forest. Unable to finish his mission or safely retreat alone, Quinn remains in hiding, waiting for travelers working for the Forsaken to aid his plight and deliver retribution to the beast that nearly tore him apart.
